description: Adds a drawing from Paletoo’s element library, found by words: 3D objects, icons, emoji, illustrations, mockups. Use it for «add a 3D heart», «a coffee cup icon in the corner». The person’s open editor places it (the design must be open); a word with no element adds nothing and says so. Example: { design, words: «coffee cup», kind: «illustration», at: «bottom-right», size: 0.3 }. Or the person’s own picture instead (`file` or `image_url`, then `words` may be empty; `picture_is`).

artboard.description: an artboard id (get_design); none: the first

design.description: the design’s id or Paletoo link

file.description: ChatGPT fills it: the picture the person attached in this chat { download_url, file_id, mime_type, file_name }; fetched once, kept with this design only

image_url.description: the person’s picture: an https link or a data: URL (PNG / JPEG / WebP ≤ ~180 KB); one you cannot pass: upload_picture — never describe or redraw it

kind.description: which part of the library (default any)

picture_is.description: photo (fills the photo frame), product or person (cut out, in the cut-out place), logo (a corner + its colours as the brand’s); auto (default): read from the file

size.description: share of the artboard’s shorter side (default 0.3)

words.description: what it shows, a noun or two (English or Ukrainian)

name: add_element
title: Add an element
